title: Vino Tahoe
specs: Only CCOF certified organic estate vineyard in Amador County
Wines crafted in small lots, hand harvested, minimal intervention, no harmful additives
Wines have won multiple awards including Best of Class and Double Gold
Winery and farmhouse are off-grid with solar power and Tesla storage batteries
blurb: Guests can visit Vino Tahoe at their estate vineyard and winery located at 15010 Ridge Road, Sutter Creek, California. The winery offers tastings on the Red Barn patio or in the cozy old 1880s farmhouse during winter. Their wines are crafted in small lots, hand harvested, with minimal intervention and no harmful additives.
extraNote: Red Barn patio for tastings and pickup orders; in winter, tastings are in the cozy old 1880s farmhouse.
